description: SQLETLBackend.load_customer_scd2_batch (added by #2316) ran BEGIN and the DimCustomer inserts on connection.cursor(), then committed the parent connection. On DuckDB, cursor() is a separate connection with its own transaction, so the inserts were never committed and DimCustomer stayed empty while the load reported success. Every tests/integration/test_tpcdi_end_to_end.py DuckDB test fails (including test_complete_etl_workflow_sqlite, whose fixture is a DuckDB file). Fix: run BEGIN, writes, and COMMIT/ROLLBACK on one handle; parametrize the SCD2 unit tests over sqlite3 and DuckDB.
